layouts:stack.title: Stack
layouts:stack.description: The default vertical flow primitive: one semantic gap and one alignment for a sequence of children. Inspired by the Every Layout Stack pattern.

layouts:cluster.title: Cluster
layouts:cluster.description: The default horizontal flow for actions, tags, metadata, and navigation that should wrap naturally instead of inventing breakpoints.

layouts:switcher.title: Switcher
layouts:switcher.description: An intrinsic layout that stays horizontal while children remain useful, then switches the whole group into a vertical flow.

layouts:reel.title: Reel
layouts:reel.description: One intentional horizontal overflow pattern for related items and media, with a fixed readable item measure and snap behavior.

layouts:cover.title: Cover
layouts:cover.description: A vertically centered full-page or section composition with optional header and footer slots, following the classic Every Layout Cover pattern.

layouts:center.title: Center
layouts:center.description: A readable maximum measure with optional shared gutters, following the Every Layout Center pattern.

layouts:frame.title: Frame
layouts:frame.description: A predictable aspect-ratio frame for media and visual fields, based on the Every Layout Frame pattern.

layouts:imposter.title: Imposter
layouts:imposter.description: A bounded centered overlay for dialogs, spotlights, and previews, following the Every Layout Imposter pattern.

layouts:pancake.title: Pancake
layouts:pancake.description: The classic auto, flexible, auto shell for a header, growing main region, and footer.
